title: 36 Hours in San Juan
abstract: Puerto Rico’s capital is open for business, welcoming visitors with its winning combination of lovely beaches, energetic night life and gregarious island charm.

title: 36 Hours in Miami and Miami Beach
abstract: From South Beach to Little Haiti and beyond, the metropolitan Miami area has plenty to offer everyone from beachgoers and music lovers to gallery hoppers and foodies.

title: 36 Hours in Goa
abstract: Known for its gorgeous beaches and hippie vibe, this tiny state in western India also offers a fascinating blend of Indian and Portuguese influences that are reflected in its buildings, cuisine and art.

title: 36 Hours in Ghent
abstract: In an often overlooked Flemish city: canals, spires, cobblestone streets and some of Belgium’s best food and design.
